description: 2b_Homer files - energy system modelling is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Katrin Lammers. Homer files that are used as basis for energy system modelling and evaluation of different scenarios for three case study islands: Hon Son Cha (Vietnam), Magyi Kyun (Myanmar) and Bulon Don (Thailand). Coverage: several countries (VN, MM, TH); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is This dataset is made available under the Open Data Commons Attribution License: http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/by/1.0/. A summary of the license. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
